div.div:
How AirArabia making mapping for seats?
- In SpecialServiceOption List, it contains
List of SeatAvailabilityMatrix which contains ONLY one Object
- SeatAvailabilityMatrix contains some meta data, in addition to
List of HasMap which contains all available seats
- Map -> key: RowNumber, Value: List of SeatRows which contains
all characteristics of this seat , in addition to its price
